kpis.label: Only Classic FICO on the mortgage price grid
kpis.statement: Classic FICO is the only score on the FHFA loan-level price grid.

binds_to.note: Classic FICO is the only score on the FHFA loan-level price grid.

kpis.label: Software revenue growth
kpis.statement: Software revenue growth is high enough to offset a weaker Scores franchise. The watch line is 8% a year. That line is ours, not management's target.

binds_to.note: Software revenue growth is high enough to offset a weaker Scores franchise. The watch line is 8% a year. That line is ours, not management's target.

kpis.label: Net debt / annualized operating income
kpis.statement: Net debt stays at or under 3 times operating income stretched to a year. This is operating income, not a company EBITDA figure.

binds_to.note: Net debt stays at or under 3 times operating income stretched to a year. This is operating income, not a company EBITDA figure.

kpis.label: Large originators preferring VantageScore
kpis.statement: Fewer than three large originators have named VantageScore as the preferred score. One name is an anecdote. Three is a pattern.

binds_to.note: Fewer than three large originators have named VantageScore as the preferred score. One name is an anecdote. Three is a pattern.

kpis.label: Bureau share of revenue
kpis.statement: Agreements with the three bureaus stay at or under 70% of quarterly revenue. They own VantageScore and distribute FICO. A rise through 70% is the steering gate. Margin has to be read with it.

kpis.label: Scores operating margin
kpis.statement: Scores operating income stays at or above 80% of Scores revenue. Fiscal 2025 was 88%. A step down is the price-cut signal. The June quarterly report does not restate this margin.
